## Summary

Describe the user-facing behavior and why it belongs in the existing four-skill architecture.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `sh scripts/validate_repository.sh`.
- [ ] I added or updated deterministic tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I regenerated `docs/components.json` when component metadata changed.
- [ ] I updated README/CHANGELOG for user-facing changes.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, personal paths, internal registry URLs, or smoke artifacts.
- [ ] Mutating MCP operations still require explicit user selection and on-demand authentication.
- [ ] SDK installation/update still requires explicit authorization.

## Security and privacy

Explain changes to permissions, hooks, MCP data, OAuth, credentials, or generated payment code. Write “No change” when none apply.
